title_zh: 选定航空展厅的短参观路线

scenario.goal_zh: 根据展品位置和可用时间选定航空展厅的参观路线

context_zh: 游客在航空博物馆入口向工作人员咨询剩余四十分钟的参观路线。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: We only have forty minutes. Is there time to see the old passenger jet?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Yes. It's in the far hall, about five minutes from here. The early aircraft are in this nearer room.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: The large plane is what my daughter most wants to see. Should we go straight there?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: I would. You can look at the smaller exhibits on the way back if you have time.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Then we'll take the corridor to the far hall first. Is that the entrance under the blue sign?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: That's right. Follow it to the end, then turn left.
